name: agentic-stack
description: Root contract for building the agentic platform in PASS.md. Load first whenever work touches the platform: its core (Document, Planner, Graph, Judge, Ledger), any capability interface, standard, or adapter, the Dispatch or State seams, a cross-cutting guarantee, a workflow, loop, or agent composition, or any skill in this repo. Fixes the vocabulary, the seven design rules as pass/fail tests, claimed versus measured labeling, the definition of done, and how skills cite the knowledge base. Every other skill assumes this one is loaded.

purpose.text: Turn PASS.md Part B into linked skills without inventing facts: every statement cites a knowledge-base record derived from PASS.md, and everything that is ours is marked proposed.
purpose.quote: Part A names products. Part B names capabilities and the standard that governs each

invariants.text: Rule 1 as a test: does the core import only interfaces? A product name inside core code, core docs, or a core skill fails.
invariants.quote: The core imports interfaces, never implementations

invariants.text: Rule 2 as a test: does each interface name its governing standard? An interface without a cited standard is either mis-drawn or belongs in B5.
invariants.quote: Each interface names the standard that governs it

invariants.text: Rule 3 as a test: does the interface ship with two adapters, the second different enough to prove the first is not load-bearing?
invariants.quote: Every interface ships with at least two adapters, and the second exists to prove the first is not load-bearing

invariants.text: Rule 4 as a test: can a caller integrate with nothing we wrote? A required client library of ours means the boundary is bespoke.
invariants.quote: If integration requires our SDK, a boundary is bespoke where a standard existed

invariants.text: Rule 5 as a test: is cost known before execution starts? Planning is a pure function that completes before execution.
invariants.quote: Planning is a pure function and completes before execution begins

invariants.text: Rule 6 as a test: is the grading criterion hidden from the thing graded? An agent sees its outcome, never the criterion.
invariants.quote: An agent sees its outcome, never the criterion it is judged against

invariants.text: Rule 7 as a test: are telemetry, policy, provenance, and budget applied by the platform with no opt-out?
invariants.quote: Telemetry, policy, provenance and budget are applied by the platform, not requested by the caller

invariants.text: Part A names products. Part B names capabilities and standards. If Part B cannot swap an implementation without touching the core, the boundary is wrong.
invariants.quote: If Part B cannot swap an implementation without touching the core, the boundary is drawn wrong

invariants.text: The core is exactly Document, Planner, Graph, Judge, Ledger. Zero outward dependencies. Everything else is an adapter.
invariants.quote: This is the entire owned surface. Everything else is an adapter.

invariants.text: Dispatch and State are the only boundaries with no standard to adopt and the only places original design is warranted.
invariants.quote: Two boundaries have no standard to adopt

not_exposed.text: Products, versions, and hostnames do not appear in core, interface, or composition material. They belong in adapter columns only.
not_exposed.quote: Products belong in the adapter column only

instructions.action: Run `python3 tools/kb.py verify` before citing anything. If it fails, rebuild with `python3 tools/kb.py build` and re-check every skill's provenance heads.
instructions.why: A fact is only sourceable while the knowledge base still matches PASS.md byte for byte. The chain and file hash make a silent edit detectable, the same idea as the hash-chained task store.
instructions.quote: each run's closing digest is the next run's opening digest, so a manual edit between runs is detectable

instructions.action: Resolve every id you rely on with `python3 tools/kb.py show <id>` and read the exact text and its line range before restating it.
instructions.why: Restating from memory is how claims get upgraded to measurements. The record carries the status derived from the text; keep it.

instructions.action: Write skills as `skill.json` conforming to `schemas/skill.schema.json`; render SKILL.md with `python3 tools/render_skill.py <dir>`; never edit SKILL.md by hand.
instructions.why: Proposed: our convention. A rendered file cannot drift from its data, and the validator rejects one that does.

instructions.action: Mark every statement origin=sourced with at least one F-, E-, or R- id, or origin=proposed with the word proposed in the text.
instructions.why: Proposed: our convention. The reader must be able to tell, per row, what PASS.md says and what we added.

instructions.action: Name capabilities and standards everywhere except the Adapters section. Cite a standard's version, or write unverified.
instructions.why: Products in the core mean the adapter has leaked into the architecture. An invented version number is a fabrication.
instructions.quote: name capabilities and standards, never products

instructions.action: Give every piece a definition of done with a machine-checkable criterion, a deliberate breakage, and the status of both (claimed until run).
instructions.why: A criterion nothing can fail is not a criterion. A green gate can be structurally green and mean nothing.
instructions.quote: A criterion nothing can fail is not a criterion

instructions.action: Fill composes_with with exact skill names from docs/skill-manifest.json and run `python3 tools/validate_skills.py` until it reports zero errors. This root skill is the one exception: its own composes_with is empty by design, so read 'Builds on: -' and 'Used by: -' here as 'exempt', not as 'unused' - every other skill lists agentic-stack under builds_on and the validator exempts the root from the used_by symmetry check.
instructions.why: Proposed: our convention. The links are the architecture graph; the validator checks they are symmetric and that nothing is cited that does not exist. Listing every skill in the root's used_by would restate the whole manifest in a file that changes on every new skill.

instructions.action: Treat Part A as substrate. Do not propose replacing what runs; describe it only as today's adapter.
instructions.why: The ask constrains it, and Part B's own framing says today's components appear only as adapters.
instructions.quote: Part A is substrate, not scope. Do not propose replacing what runs.

best_practices.text: Correlation must ride on an explicit resource attribute set at dispatch, because trace context did not survive the agent boundary when tried.
best_practices.quote: Correlation must ride on an explicit resource attribute set at dispatch

best_practices.text: Well-formedness checks (diff, syntax, format) are not correctness checks; a gate whose behavioural stages all skipped proves nothing.
Configuration written in the documented place can be silently overridden by a stored row; verify runtime effect, not file contents.
best_practices.quote: Values written to YAML validated, reviewed correctly, and had no runtime effect

best_practices.text: Callers request a class of model, never a vendor; the prefix carries the contract.
best_practices.quote: Callers request a class, never a vendor

best_practices.text: Load skills narrowly: this one, then the layer skill for the piece in hand, then only the neighbours it names under composes_with. (proposed: our convention, not in PASS.md)

definition_of_done.expected: kb verified; N skills checked, 0 errors
definition_of_done.breakage: Change one character of one fact's text in kb/facts.jsonl (the record no longer hashes to its stored digest), run the criterion (tools/kb.py verify reports the chain broken and exits non-zero), then git checkout kb/facts.jsonl.
definition_of_done.expected_failure: kb verify: 'FAIL: chain broken at facts F-meta-01' and 'text does not match PASS.md lines 3-3'; validate_skills: 'cites unknown id F-none-99' and 'quote is not a verbatim substring'. Measured in session claude/auto-skill-creation-i8javu on 2026-09-03; both breakages exited 1 and the restored state exited 0.
definition_of_done.quote: A criterion nothing can fail is not a criterion
